title: A representable transformation with sheaf target has sheaf source
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for functors F, G on (Sch/S)_{fppf}^{opp} and a representable transformation a : F -> G, if G is a sheaf then so is F (source lines 433-439). The proof runs the sheaf condition by hand: images sigma_i of a compatible family s_i form a compatible family in G, glue to a unique sigma, and the compatible family (phi_i, s_i) in the representable presheaf F' = h_T x_{sigma,G,a} F - a sheaf - glues to a unique (id_T, s), which is the required section of F.
